g.text: py-app-sticker-terminal-betaalmerken | type sticker | trim 104.97 x 30.61 mm, bleed 3 mm | status rebuilt
Bron: elf printbestanden (source/print). Referentie = getrouwe vectorweergave; template = officiele tokenkleuren, 3 mm bleed, variabelen als live tekst. Labels staan in aparte groepen.
Bron: TerminalStickers_September2026.pdf p1 (CMYK; bleed box in bron nee). Template: trim 104.97 x 30.61 mm, bleed 3 mm, totaal 110.97 x 36.61 mm.
Variabelen: badges = maestro-badge, mastercard-badge, visa, vpay

Snijcontour: groep cut-contour, spot ThruCut, 1 pt, 0.2 mm binnen de trim. Proposal: the source has only a 0.25 pt hairline as die line, no ThruCut contour. Radius measured on the die line, to be confirmed by the printer.

Four round navy badges (19.6 mm) with Maestro, Mastercard, VISA and V PAY, composed from py-atom-badge-round-navy and the third party mark atoms (reference only, source the official files). Each badge is a group badge-<name>: remove a group to change the accepted cards. Sheet TerminalStickers_September2026.pdf (271 x 391 mm, no

bleed, no trim marks): a hairline die line (black, 0.25 to 0.74 pt) around each white sticker. The template replaces that line by a ThruCut contour 0.2 mm inside the trim and adds a 3 mm bleed. Source blue CMYK 99.5/85/21.4/6.8 (drift, see tokens.json observed): the template uses the token blue.
